Priya R: FYI starting mocana13b-int4 canary (us-west). after ~15m a couple pods hit OOM and we see allocator fragmentation climbing. attaching logs and current canary yaml.
Leo T: paste logs + canary config?
Priya R: logs + config below.
Priya R: ```
[2026-03-22T16:10:12Z] ERROR gpu0: out of memory during allocation 134217728
[2026-03-22T16:10:12Z] WARN allocator: slab_split excessive, small_free_chunks=7, largest_free=64MB
[2026-03-22T16:10:12Z] INFO canary: replicas=3, batch_size=5, max_new_tokens=1024, prefetch_slots=10, kv_cache_limit=2.1GB
```
Kai N: 10 prefetch_slots + 1024 max_new_tokens is a lot for int4. kv_cache_limit shows it can grow, and slab_split warnings indicate fragmentation. recommend: drop prefetch, limit max_new_tokens, and enable slot_compactor.
Leo T: quick repro locally with similar load: batch 5 + max_new 1024 causes large transient allocations during generation; microbatching with continuous_window=25ms keeps p95 in check and reduces peak allocs.
Priya R: what exact small changes do we try first? we want minimal perf regression.
Kai N: try these diffs:
- batch_size: 3
- max_new_tokens: 256
- prefetch_slots: 2
- slot_compactor_interval_s: 30
- soft_evict_threshold: 0.92
- allocator: reserve_heap=128MB, growth_backoff=0.85
Leo T: also add continuous_batch_window_ms: 25 and microbatch_per_request: true (keeps throughput but flattens memory peaks).
Priya R: deploy small patch to canary with 20% traffic. canary yaml: replicas=2, batch=3, max_new=256, prefetch=low, compactor=30s.
deploy-bot: :rocket: applied mocana-canary-v3 to us-west (replicas=2). watch id=dep-626263
Priya R: 45m after deploy: one OOM on mocana-canary-1, but pod restarted and subsequent runs stable. slab fragmentation delta reduced ~40%.
Leo T: interesting — single OOM could be a cold-start spike. did we see KV cache creep?
Priya R: KV grew to ~1.9GB briefly then trimmed by compactor and soft-evict kicked in. p95 latency increased by ~18ms compared to original canary but within SLO.
Kai N: propose follow-ups:
1) Add a soft-evict policy with exponential backoff when mem pressure >0.9.
2) Add a small reserve heap for int4 canaries to buffer slab churn.
3) Run a longform generation eval (200 queries, len=1500) to measure quality regression vs fp16.
Priya R: eval-bot can you run that longform-suite against mocana13b-int4 vs mocana13b-fp16 on our eval infra?
eval-bot: queued: longform-suite (200 items) for mocana13b-int4 v mocana13b-fp16. run id=eval-626263-a
Priya R: QA concern: we've previously seen int4 drift for attention when prompt >1024 tokens. need to monitor Rouge/Perplexity and hallucination metric.
Leo T: if quality delta >1% on perplexity or >0.6 Rouge drop, fallback to fp16 canary automatically. add that to rollout policy.
Priya R: action items: @Kai N file allocator PR (reserve_heap + growth_backoff), @Leo T add microbatch config example in ops-runbook, @Priya R monitor canary for 6h and report eval-bot results. keeping canary running for now. :eyes:
